subtitle.zh: 10 天建立系统地图，完成第一份工程作品
subtitle.en: Map the stack and build your first engineering portfolio in 10 days

description.zh: 用普通电脑跟做 10 天：看懂请求时间线，运行内存计算器与排队模拟器，独立计算指标，再生成一份有原始数据的工程作品。每天提供图解、实验命令、输出对照、报错排查与带解析测验。
description.en: Follow ten laptop-friendly days: visualize a request, run a memory calculator and queue simulator, calculate metrics independently, and produce an evidence-backed project. Each day includes diagrams, commands, expected results, troubleshooting and explained quizzes.

hoursPerDay.zh: 每天 90–120 分钟，共约 15–20 小时
hoursPerDay.en: 90–120 minutes a day; about 15–20 hours total

prerequisites.zh: 能运行 Python 脚本，理解列表、函数和基本代数；会用终端与 Git 保存文件。无需已有大模型部署经验。
prerequisites.en: Run Python scripts, understand lists, functions and basic algebra, and use a terminal and Git. No prior LLM deployment experience is required.

hardware.zh: 普通电脑，Python 3.9 或更新版本，仅使用标准库，无需安装依赖、下载模型或购买 GPU。所有教学时钟与缓存示例均为模拟；第 4 天仅测本机 Python CPU 操作。
hardware.en: An ordinary computer with Python 3.9+, standard library only. No packages, model download or GPU purchase required. Teaching clocks and cache examples are synthetic; day 4 times only local Python CPU work.

zh: AI Infra 初级工程师
推理平台工程师
技术支持与开发者工程师
en: Junior AI infrastructure engineer
Inference platform engineer
Developer support engineer

outcome.zh: 一个可复现的基础实验作品：包含 10 日脚本、JSON/JSONL 原始记录、CSV 对照表、环境与代码哈希、独立实现的指标函数和本人填写的技术报告。
outcome.en: A reproducible foundations project with ten daily scripts, raw JSON/JSONL, a comparison CSV, environment and source hashes, independently implemented metric functions and your own technical report.

title.zh: 画出一条 AI 请求的旅程
title.en: Map the journey of an AI request

lesson.zh: 先把一个 AI 请求看成沿着时间轴经过多个组件的工作。用户发出请求后，输入会被校验，随后可能排队；模型处理输入的阶段称为 prefill，随后逐步生成输出称为 decode。第一次看到输出与收到全部输出发生在不同时间，因此“响应快”至少包含首个输出等待与整体完成两个问题。今天用一个确定的教学时间线看清这些阶段，不启动模型，也不把它当作真实服务测量。
lesson.en: View an AI request as work moving through components on a timeline. Validation can be followed by queuing. Prefill processes input; decode incrementally produces output. Seeing the first output and receiving the complete answer happen at different times, so responsiveness includes both first-output waiting and overall completion. Today uses a deterministic teaching timeline, not a running model or a real service measurement.

task.zh: 运行 day1，检查 JSON 并手算各阶段时长；画出自己的请求流程，注明可能在输入、排队、执行、交付哪个阶段失败。
task.en: Run day1, inspect its JSON, calculate each duration and draw a request flow with possible failures in input, queue, execution and delivery.

evidence.zh: day01-timeline.json 与一张本人解释的请求流程图；标明教学模拟。
evidence.en: day01-timeline.json plus your annotated request-flow diagram, labeled as a teaching simulation.

body.zh: 把聊天文本想成任务材料，模型权重是执行任务所需的参数。HTTP 服务负责接收与返回，调度器安排何时执行，模型执行层完成计算。某个环节出错时，需要先定位它属于哪一层。例如格式无效的请求通常还没进入模型计算。
body.en: Think of chat text as the task material and weights as the parameters used to perform the task. HTTP handles receipt and responses, the scheduler decides when work runs, and the executor performs computation. An invalid request can fail before model computation begins.

body.zh: 本例校验从 0 到 2 ms，排队到 12 ms，prefill 到 32 ms，decode 到 62 ms，最终交付到 65 ms。假设第一个可见 token 在 32 ms，因此首输出等待是 32 ms，整体完成是 65 ms。真实客户端还可能遇到网络、流式缓冲与分词差异；本例有意省略它们。
body.en: Validation runs from 0 to 2 ms, queuing ends at 12, prefill at 32, decode at 62, and delivery at 65. The example assumes the first visible token at 32 ms, so first-output waiting is 32 ms and completion is 65 ms. Real clients add network, streaming-buffer and tokenization effects, deliberately omitted here.

title.zh: 一条请求经过哪些阶段？

caption.zh: 教学示意：第一个可见 token 设在 32 ms，时间不是硬件实测。
caption.en: Teaching example: the first visible token is assumed at 32 ms. These are not hardware measurements.

body.zh: 点击课程顶部的实验包，解压得到 foundations 文件夹，在终端进入该文件夹。下面命令假定你已在解压位置；若终端还在下载目录，先执行 cd foundations。Windows 可把 python3 替换为 py -3。
body.en: Download the lab above and unzip it to a foundations folder. Open a terminal there; from its parent directory use cd foundations. On Windows, replace python3 with py -3 if needed.

question.zh: 时间线中首次输出在 32 ms、完成在 65 ms，整体延迟是多少？
question.en: First output is at 32 ms and completion at 65 ms. What is end-to-end latency?

explanation.zh: 请求从 0 ms 开始，整体延迟为 65−0。33 ms 是首次输出到完成的差值。
explanation.en: The request starts at 0, so end-to-end latency is 65−0. The 33 ms difference covers only first output to completion.

title.zh: 理解 token、张量与 KV cache
title.en: Understand tokens, tensors and KV cache

lesson.zh: token 是模型使用的离散单位，字符数通常不等于 token 数。张量形状描述数据有多少个元素，精度决定每个元素占多少字节。自回归模型可保存已经处理的 token 对应的 K/V 状态，以减少后续重复计算；但这些状态要占用内存。今天从一个明确写出维度的教学模型出发，手算并运行 KV 容量计算器。
lesson.en: Tokens are the discrete units used by a model; character counts usually differ from token counts. Tensor shape determines the element count and precision determines bytes per element. Autoregressive models can retain K/V state from processed tokens to avoid repeated computation, at a memory cost. Today calculates that cost for explicitly declared teaching dimensions.

task.zh: 完成四组容量表，再把精度或并发改一个值，先预测再运行验证；记录公式成立的假设。

title.zh: 把公式拆成可数的维度

body.zh: 在每层都保留完整历史、无共享/压缩/分片的简化情况下：字节数 = 2 × 层数 × KV 头数 × 每头维度 × token 数 × 序列数 × 每元素字节数。最前面的 2 表示 K 和 V；KV 头数不能直接用 query 头数替换。
body.en: For a full-history cache in every layer, without sharing, compression or sharding: bytes = 2 × layers × KV heads × head dimension × tokens × sequences × bytes per element. The first 2 counts K and V. KV-head count is not interchangeable with query-head count.

body.zh: 示例设 32 层、8 个 KV 头、每头 128 维、2 字节精度。一条 2048-token 序列需要 268435456 字节，即 0.25 GiB。上下文扩大到 8192 是 4 倍，8 条序列再乘 8。这里只算 KV，不包含权重、激活或运行时工作区。
body.en: With 32 layers, 8 KV heads, dimension 128 and two-byte elements, one 2048-token sequence needs 268435456 bytes, or 0.25 GiB. Increasing context to 8192 multiplies this by four; eight sequences multiply it by eight again. This excludes weights, activations and runtime workspace.

title.zh: 从 token 到显存估算
title.en: From tokens to a memory estimate

caption.zh: GiB 使用 2 的 30 次方换算；公式仅适用于这里声明的缓存结构。
caption.en: A GiB is 2^30 bytes. The formula applies only to the declared cache structure.

body.zh: 先在纸上算 2048 token、1 条序列的容量，再运行代码，核对四个组合。
body.en: Calculate the 2048-token, one-sequence case on paper, then compare all four scripted combinations.

expected.zh: 按顺序得到 0.25、2.0、1.0、8.0 GiB；组合写在 day02-kv.json。
expected.en: Outputs 0.25, 2.0, 1.0 and 8.0 GiB in order; combinations are recorded in day02-kv.json.

body.zh: 直接调用 kv_bytes，把序列数改成 2。检查它是否恰好翻倍。再试用 0 作为 token 数，观察输入检查。
body.en: Call kv_bytes with two sequences and verify the exact doubling. Then try zero tokens to observe input validation.

expected.zh: 输出 0.5。输入 0 时应报 ValueError，而不是悄悄接受无效容量。
expected.en: Prints 0.5. Zero input should raise ValueError instead of accepting an invalid capacity.

symptom.zh: 计算结果差了约 7%
symptom.en: Result differs by about 7%

fix.zh: 检查使用的是 GB（10^9）还是 GiB（2^30）；不要混用单位。
fix.en: Check whether the denominator is GB (10^9) or GiB (2^30); do not mix the units.

symptom.zh: 把估算值当作实际启动需要的总显存
symptom.en: Treating KV size as total required device memory

fix.zh: 还要加入权重、工作区、额外缓冲和余量；滑动窗口、MLA、共享与分片还会改变缓存模型。
fix.en: Add weights, workspace, extra buffers and reserve. Sliding windows, MLA, sharing and sharding can also change the cache model.

question.zh: 本例把序列数从 1 改为 8，其他条件不变，KV 估算如何变化？
question.en: In this model, changing sequences from 1 to 8 changes the KV estimate how?

explanation.zh: 无共享的线性模型里，每条序列都有自己的历史状态。
explanation.en: In this unshared linear model, each sequence has its own historical state.

question.zh: 公式中的第一个 2 表示什么？
question.en: What does the first 2 in the formula represent?

options.zh: K 和 V 两份状态

explanation.zh: 精度占用已由 bytes_per_element 单独计算。
explanation.en: Precision is already accounted for separately by bytes_per_element.

title.zh: 把用户体验翻译成指标

lesson.zh: 性能报告需要明确时间起点、成功范围与统计口径。TTFT 是请求发出到首 token 的等待，端到端延迟是发出到完成；平均 TPOT 常用首 token 到末 token 的时间除以其间 token 间隔数。先把这些公式放到固定合成记录上，检查错误、超时、空数据和只生成一个 token 的边界，再迁移到真实服务。
lesson.en: A performance report needs explicit timing origins, success criteria and aggregation rules. TTFT covers request start to the first token; end-to-end latency covers start to completion. Mean TPOT commonly divides first-to-last-token time by the number of token intervals. Verify formulas on fixed synthetic records, including errors, timeouts, empty input and one-token outputs, before using them on a real service.

task.zh: 核对 JSONL 中三个边界样本，实现 student.py 的两个指标函数并通过独立验收。
task.en: Inspect three boundary cases in JSONL, implement both student.py functions and pass independent checks.

body.zh: 若 start=100、first=125、end=165 ms，生成 5 个 token，则 TTFT=25 ms，整体=65 ms，TPOT=(165−125)/(5−1)=10 ms。只生成一个 token 时不存在后续间隔，TPOT 应记为无数据，而不是除以零或强行写 0。
body.en: For start=100, first=125 and end=165 ms with five output tokens, TTFT=25 ms, total latency=65 ms and TPOT=(165−125)/(5−1)=10 ms. One-token output has no later token interval, so TPOT is unavailable, not zero.

title.zh: 分位数与失败都要留下

body.zh: 本课采用最近秩定义：排序后取 ceil(q×n) 个值，计数从 1 开始。20 个值的 p95 是第 19 个。成功延迟只统计成功请求，但失败率分母必须包含全部请求；不要静默删除超时。不同工具的分位数插值方法可能不同，报告应写明定义。
body.en: We use nearest rank: take the ceil(q×n)-th sorted value, counting from one. For 20 values, p95 is the 19th. Successful latency uses successful requests, while failure-rate denominators include every request. Tools can use different interpolation rules; state your definition.

title.zh: 保留原始记录，再做统计

caption.zh: 失败仍保留在原始日志中；单 token 请求不进入 TPOT 平均值。
caption.en: Failures remain in raw logs. One-token requests are excluded from mean TPOT.

body.zh: 运行脚本后打开 JSONL，每行是一条请求。找到 r00、r22 与 r23，解释为什么它们的统计处理不同。
body.en: Run the script and open JSONL, one request per line. Locate r00, r22 and r23 and explain their different treatment.

expected.zh: 24 条记录、22 成功、1 错误、1 超时；p95 TTFT=35 ms，TPOT 样本数=21。
expected.en: 24 records, 22 successes, one error and one timeout; p95 TTFT=35 ms; 21 TPOT samples.

body.zh: 打开 student.py，实现 failure_rate 与 nearest_rank。先用空列表、单值、包含超时的记录手算，再执行 check.py。遇到 NOT YET 说明挑战尚未完成，不是环境安装失败；提示见 README。

symptom.en: ZeroDivisionError

fix.zh: TPOT 只接收 output_tokens>1 的成功记录；空请求集的失败率返回 None。
fix.en: Compute TPOT only for successful records with output_tokens>1; return None for an empty failure-rate input.

symptom.zh: 算出的失败率是 0
symptom.en: Failure rate appears as zero

fix.zh: 检查是否在统计失败率之前把失败请求过滤掉了；本例应为 2/24，约 8.33%。
fix.en: Check whether failures were filtered out before calculating the rate. This dataset has 2/24 failures, about 8.33%.

question.zh: 5 个输出 token 的 first=20、end=60 ms，TPOT 是多少？
question.en: Five output tokens have first=20 and end=60 ms. What is TPOT?

explanation.zh: 5 个 token 有 4 个相邻间隔，40/4=10。
explanation.en: Five tokens create four intervals, so 40/4=10.

question.zh: 空数据集的 p95 应该输出什么？
question.en: What should p95 return for an empty dataset?

options.zh: 无数据，并说明没有样本

explanation.zh: 零会把缺少测量误表述为零延迟；本实验使用 None。
explanation.en: Zero would misrepresent missing measurements as zero latency; this lab uses None.

title.zh: 区分计算瓶颈与数据搬运瓶颈

lesson.zh: 一个算子既要计算，也要搬运数据。只看运算次数或 GPU 利用率，无法解释所有性能问题。算术强度用 FLOP/byte 描述理想计算量与数据量的比例；它帮助提出瓶颈假设，但不能单独预测实际速度。今天对向量加法和矩阵乘法手算，再用 Python 列表观察本机 CPU 时间，明确理想模型与真实实现的差别。
lesson.en: An operator both computes and moves data. Operation count or GPU utilization alone cannot explain every performance issue. Arithmetic intensity, in FLOP/byte, compares ideal compute with data movement. It suggests bottleneck hypotheses but does not alone predict speed. Today contrasts vector addition and matrix multiplication, then observes local Python list timings while separating an ideal model from an actual implementation.

task.zh: 运行并重复 CPU 计时，手算两种理想强度，写清至少两个估算或测量限制。
task.en: Run and repeat CPU timings, calculate both ideal intensities and state at least two estimation or measurement limits.

body.zh: 假设 float32 向量加法 c=a+b，每个元素读取 a 和 b 共 8 字节，写 c 4 字节，完成 1 次加法。理想强度为 1/12≈0.0833 FLOP/byte。忽略缓存、写分配等细节后，这个量提示数据搬运可能很重要。
body.en: For float32 c=a+b, each element reads eight bytes from a and b, writes four bytes to c and performs one addition. Ideal intensity is 1/12≈0.0833 FLOP/byte. This ignores cache and write-allocation effects, but highlights potentially important data movement.

body.zh: n×n 矩阵乘法约有 2n³ 次浮点运算，若 A、B 各读一次且 C 写一次，理想数据量为 12n² 字节，强度为 n/6。n=384 时是 64 FLOP/byte。这个上界依赖充分复用；朴素循环不保证达到它，Python float 对象也不是紧凑 float32 数组。
body.en: An n×n multiplication has about 2n³ floating-point operations. Reading A and B once and writing C once costs 12n² bytes, giving intensity n/6: 64 FLOP/byte at n=384. This ideal requires reuse; naive loops do not guarantee it, and Python float objects are not packed float32 arrays.

title.zh: 从计算量和流量提出假设
title.en: Build a hypothesis from compute and traffic

caption.zh: 本课 CPU 时间用于观察实现开销，不能推导 GPU 带宽。
caption.en: CPU timings illustrate implementation overhead and cannot establish GPU bandwidth.

title.zh: 运行成本算例与 CPU 计时
title.en: Run cost examples and CPU timings

body.zh: 脚本会对三个列表规模进行加法，验证结果正确并记录 perf_counter 时间。
body.en: The script adds lists at three sizes, checks correctness and records perf_counter elapsed time.

expected.zh: 理想强度分别为 0.083333 与 64 FLOP/byte；CPU 时间随电脑和当时负载变化。
expected.en: Ideal intensities are 0.083333 and 64 FLOP/byte. CPU times vary with the machine and its load.

body.zh: 把第二次结果保存到另一个目录，与第一次比较。不要因为一次大规模运行更快就推断计算复杂度变了；记录进程负载、计时分辨率和 Python 开销。
body.en: Save a second run to another directory and compare. A larger sample being faster once does not imply changed complexity; document system load, timer resolution and Python overhead.

expected.zh: repeat-day4/day04-cost.json 包含第二组时间；数值不要求相同。
expected.en: repeat-day4/day04-cost.json contains a second set of timings; equality is not expected.

symptom.zh: 重复计时不一样
symptom.en: Repeated timings differ

fix.zh: 这是本机实际 CPU 计时，受调度等因素影响。保留多次观测并说明范围，不挑最快值冒充稳定性能。
fix.en: These are actual CPU timings affected by scheduling. Preserve multiple observations and their range instead of presenting the fastest as stable performance.

symptom.zh: 用 Python 对象大小代入 float32 公式
symptom.en: Using Python object sizes in the float32 formula

fix.zh: 公式描述理想紧凑数组；当前代码实现是 Python 列表。两者分开报告，不把估算字节数除以列表时间当作硬件带宽。
fix.en: The formula models packed arrays; the implementation uses Python lists. Report them separately instead of dividing ideal bytes by list time to claim hardware bandwidth.

question.zh: float32 向量加法的理想每元素数据量是多少？
question.en: What is the ideal float32 vector-add traffic per element?

explanation.zh: 两个输入各 4 字节，再写一个 4 字节输出。
explanation.en: Two four-byte inputs plus one four-byte output.

question.zh: 本机 Python 加法时间能直接证明 GPU 内存带宽吗？
question.en: Can local Python addition timing directly establish GPU memory bandwidth?

options.zh: 不能，执行设备与数据表示都不同

explanation.zh: 没有运行 GPU，也未测量 GPU 数据搬运。
explanation.en: No GPU work or GPU data transfer was measured.

title.zh: 用模拟器理解排队与批处理
title.en: Learn queuing and batching with a simulator

lesson.zh: 服务没有立即处理请求时，请求会排队。批处理可以把多条请求放在一起执行，但它的收益依赖执行成本和到达方式；单条请求也可能因为额外开销变慢。今天提供一个小型、完整的 FIFO 模拟器，从两条请求手算开始，再比较均匀到达与突发到达。所有时间都是教学设定，不代表 vLLM 调度算法。
lesson.en: Requests queue when a server cannot handle them immediately. Batching can execute several requests together, but benefits depend on service cost and arrivals; extra overhead can slow an individual request. Today starts with two hand-calculated FIFO requests and a complete small simulator, then compares steady and burst arrivals. All times are teaching assumptions, not a model of the full vLLM scheduler.

task.zh: 跑通两请求算例与四组实验，改变到达间隔为 4 ms，解释实际批大小与等待如何变化。
task.en: Run the two-request example and four conditions, then change arrivals to 4 ms apart and explain batch size and wait changes.

evidence.zh: day05 原始日志、comparison.json 与本人修改到达间隔的对照说明。
evidence.en: Day 5 raw traces, comparison.json and an explanation of your arrival-interval experiment.

title.zh: 先用两条请求理解 FIFO

body.zh: 设两条请求在 0 和 3 ms 到达，每条服务 8 ms。第一条从 0 到 8，第二条从 8 到 16；第二条等待 8−3=5 ms。代码中的 now 表示服务可用时间，每次取 max(now,arrival)，这样既不会在请求到达前执行，也不会凭空产生等待。
body.en: Two requests arrive at 0 and 3 ms, each needing 8 ms. The first runs 0–8 and the second 8–16, so the second waits 5 ms. now represents server availability; max(now, arrival) prevents execution before arrival and avoids invented waiting.

body.zh: batch4 每次最多选择 4 条已经到达的请求，没有额外凑批等待计时器；该批次时长设为 2+最长服务时长。这个并行成本是教学假设。12 条同时到达时 FIFO 需 96 ms，batch4 需 3×10=30 ms；每 12 ms 才到一条时没有批可合并，额外 2 ms 反而增加单请求延迟。
body.en: batch4 selects up to four already-arrived requests without an extra batching timer. Its duration is assumed to be 2 plus the longest service time. This parallel cost is a teaching assumption: 12 simultaneous requests take 96 ms with FIFO or 3×10=30 ms with batch4. At one arrival every 12 ms, batches remain single-item and the extra 2 ms increases latency.

title.zh: 从到达时间推进模拟时钟
title.en: Advance the simulated clock from arrivals

caption.zh: 仅演示非抢占 FIFO 与固定批次，不实现连续批处理或真实 token 调度。
caption.en: Models non-preemptive FIFO and fixed batches, not continuous batching or real token scheduling.

body.zh: 调用 queue 并检查第二条的 start_ms 和 wait_ms。读 lab.py 中 queue 的 while 循环，对照上方手算。
body.en: Call queue and inspect the second start_ms and wait_ms. Read the while loop in lab.py alongside the worked example.

expected.zh: 第二条 start_ms=8、wait_ms=5、end_ms=16。
expected.en: The second request has start_ms=8, wait_ms=5 and end_ms=16.

body.zh: 运行均匀/突发 × FIFO/batch4 的四组实验，查看 comparison 和对应原始日志。解释哪一组没有批处理收益。
body.en: Run steady/burst × FIFO/batch4 and inspect the comparison plus raw traces. Explain which condition does not benefit.

expected.zh: 突发 FIFO 完成 96 ms，batch4 完成 30 ms；均匀到达时 batch4 单次服务 10 ms，FIFO 为 8 ms。
expected.en: Burst FIFO completes at 96 ms and batch4 at 30 ms. With steady arrivals, batch4 service is 10 ms versus FIFO 8 ms.

symptom.zh: 以为 batch4 总会凑够 4 条
symptom.en: Assuming batch4 always waits for four items

fix.zh: 检查 batch_size_actual；这里只合并已到达请求，不等待未来请求。真实凑批超时策略是另一项实验。
fix.en: Inspect batch_size_actual. This model batches only arrived requests; it does not wait for future ones. A batching timeout would be a separate experiment.

symptom.zh: 把 96/30 写成 vLLM 加速倍数
symptom.en: Reporting 96/30 as a vLLM speedup

fix.zh: 该比值来自我们设定的服务成本，未运行任何引擎。报告写“在此教学模型和突发负载下”。
fix.en: The ratio follows the declared cost model; no engine ran. State “under this teaching model and burst workload.”

question.zh: 请求在 3 ms 到达，服务在 8 ms 开始，等待多久？
question.en: A request arrives at 3 ms and starts at 8 ms. What is its wait?

explanation.zh: 等待时间等于 start−arrival。
explanation.en: Waiting time is start−arrival.

question.zh: 为什么稀疏请求在本例批处理下会变慢？
question.en: Why do sparse requests get slower with batching in this example?

options.zh: 模型增加了 2 ms 开销，但没有可合并请求
options.en: The model adds 2 ms with no requests to combine

options.zh: 真实 GPU 已经满载

explanation.zh: 时长由教学成本定义，稀疏流量下每批只有一条。
explanation.en: The teaching cost adds overhead while sparse batches contain only one request.

title.zh: 缓存命中之前，先保证正确性

lesson.zh: 缓存的第一要求是正确复用。只因为两段文字看起来相似，就复用内部状态，可能得到错误结果。今天用 Python 字典认识缓存身份：模型版本、命名空间与一组 token ID 共同决定一个键。这个小例子只做完全相同键的复用，帮助理解失配原因；它不实现 vLLM 的块哈希、部分前缀匹配或实际模型计算。
lesson.en: A cache must reuse state correctly. Reusing internal state merely because text looks similar can be incorrect. A Python dictionary introduces cache identity: model version, namespace and token IDs jointly form a key. This example reuses only an identical key to teach mismatch causes; it does not implement vLLM block hashes, partial-prefix matching or model computation.

task.zh: 运行五个缓存用例，在副本里构造缺少模型字段的错误键，再解释并修复误命中。
task.en: Run five cache cases, construct an incomplete key in a copy, then explain and fix the false hit.

evidence.zh: day06-cache.json、错误键与修复键的差异、正确性解释。
evidence.en: day06-cache.json, the incorrect/correct key diff and a correctness explanation.

body.zh: 键使用 (model, namespace, tuple(tokens))。tuple 让 token 列表能作为字典键；模型变化时，即使 token 相同，也不能假定内部状态相同。命名空间在本例代表隔离边界，避免把两个用途的数据当作同一个对象。实际系统还可能需要适配器、位置编码等身份因素。
body.en: The key is (model, namespace, tuple(tokens)). A tuple makes tokens usable in a dictionary key. Changed model weights invalidate the assumption of identical state even with identical tokens. A namespace represents an isolation boundary here. Real systems may also need adapter, position and other identity factors.

title.zh: 命中不等于整个请求都免算
title.en: A hit does not eliminate all work

body.zh: 实验依次尝试首次、重复、改一个 token、改模型、改命名空间。只有重复命中。toy_tokens_reused 计数的是复用状态的教学 token 数，不是节省的实际计算时间。真实前缀缓存主要减少重复 prefill，后续新 token 的生成仍需要执行。
body.en: The cases are first use, exact repeat, changed token, changed model and changed namespace. Only the repeat hits. toy_tokens_reused counts teaching state reuse, not measured time saved. Real prefix caching primarily reduces repeated prefill; new output tokens still require work.

nodes.zh: 模型 / 命名空间 / token
命中复用 / 未命中创建

caption.zh: 精确键字典是简化教学模型；真实引擎有更复杂的块与淘汰策略。
caption.en: An exact-key dictionary is a simplified model; real engines have more complex blocks and eviction.

body.zh: 查看每一行 case、hit、toy_tokens_reused；先预测再打开结果。
body.en: Predict the result, then inspect case, hit and toy_tokens_reused in each row.

expected.zh: 命中序列为 False, True, False, False, False。
expected.en: Hit sequence: False, True, False, False, False.

title.zh: 制造一次跨模型误命中

body.zh: 在实验目录的副本中，把 key 改为只包含 tuple(tokens)，重跑并查看 changed-model 是否错误命中。随后恢复完整键。这是教学反例，不能用于真实缓存。
body.en: In a copy of the lab, change key to only tuple(tokens), rerun and inspect changed-model for an incorrect hit. Then restore the full key; this is a teaching counterexample, never a real cache policy.

expected.zh: 原版 changed-model 与 changed-namespace 均为 false；修改版的误命中说明键丢失了身份信息。
expected.en: The original changed-model and changed-namespace both miss. False hits in the modified copy expose missing identity fields.

symptom.zh: TypeError: unhashable type: 'list'
symptom.en: TypeError: unhashable type: 'list'

fix.zh: 列表可变，不能直接做字典键；将 token 列表转换为 tuple，同时保留模型与命名空间。
fix.en: Lists are mutable and cannot directly serve as dictionary keys. Convert tokens to a tuple while retaining model and namespace.

symptom.zh: 认为一个 token 改动必然让真实系统全部缓存失效
symptom.en: Assuming one changed token invalidates every real cached block

fix.zh: 我们的例子只有完整键匹配；真实块式前缀缓存可能保留之前相同的完整块。不能把简化规则外推。
fix.en: This example supports only full-key equality. Real block-based prefix caches may retain preceding identical complete blocks; do not generalize this simplified rule.

question.zh: 本例中 token 相同但模型版本改变，应怎么做？
question.en: In this example, tokens match but the model version changes. What should happen?

explanation.zh: 缓存状态依赖模型，身份不匹配不能证明状态可复用。
explanation.en: Cached state depends on the model; different identity does not establish reusable state.

question.zh: toy_tokens_reused=3 能说明什么？
question.en: What does toy_tokens_reused=3 establish?

options.zh: 教学字典复用了 3 个 token 对应的示例状态
options.en: The teaching dictionary reused example state for three tokens

explanation.zh: 没有计时真实模型，不能推导速度收益。
explanation.en: No model was timed, so a speed benefit cannot be inferred.

title.zh: 做一份能解释的资源预算

lesson.zh: 模型能否放进设备，不能只看参数量。权重、KV cache、工作区、临时张量与额外缓冲都会占用空间。预算的目的，是在运行前检查量级并声明未知项，不是保证一定不会内存不足。今天把第 2 天的 KV 计算器接入一张容量表，比较上下文变化，并讨论降级的代价。
lesson.en: Parameter count alone does not determine whether a model fits. Weights, KV cache, workspace, temporary tensors and buffers all consume memory. A budget checks scale and declares unknowns before execution; it does not guarantee freedom from out-of-memory failures. Today combines day 2 KV estimates into a capacity table and examines context changes and fallback trade-offs.

task.zh: 生成预算表，给超预算条件设计两种降级方法，并写出容量与服务能力的取舍。
task.en: Generate the table and propose two fallbacks for the over-budget case with capacity and service trade-offs.

evidence.zh: day07-budget.json、两种降级估算与未知开销说明。
evidence.en: day07-budget.json, two fallback estimates and a note on unknown overhead.

noGpu.en: This entire course runs on an ordinary CPU computer without a GPU. Use the lab pack; synthetic times are not real model measurements.

title.zh: 逐项列预算，留下未知项

body.zh: 示例权重为 10 亿参数 × 2 字节，约 1.86 GiB；KV 维度沿用第 2 天，8 条序列；额外工作区暂按 2 GiB。设备总量假设为 16 GiB，保留 20% 余量，因此预算上限 12.8 GiB。这里独立设置的参数只用于练习，不对应一个真实模型。
body.en: Example weights use one billion parameters × two bytes, about 1.86 GiB. KV dimensions come from day 2 with eight sequences. Workspace is assumed to be 2 GiB. A hypothetical 16 GiB device reserves 20%, leaving 12.8 GiB. These independent values are illustrative and do not describe a real model.

body.zh: 减少并发会降低同时保存的状态，但可能降低承载量；缩短上下文会减小 KV，但限制输入长度。量化改变元素字节数，也引入支持与质量问题。不要默认所有占用都随某一个开关线性缩小；把未知工作区和余量单独写出来。
body.en: Lower concurrency stores fewer simultaneous states but can reduce capacity. Shorter context reduces KV while limiting input length. Quantization changes bytes per element and adds support and quality concerns. Do not assume one switch scales every allocation; record workspace uncertainty and reserve separately.

title.en: Four parts of a capacity estimate

caption.zh: 预算通过只说明假设下估算可容纳，仍需真实环境验证。
caption.en: Passing the estimate means only that declared assumptions fit; real execution must still be checked.

body.zh: 查看 JSON 中 required_gib 与 budget_after_20_percent_reserve_gib，手算为什么最后一档超出。
body.en: Compare required_gib with budget_after_20_percent_reserve_gib and calculate why the last case exceeds it.

expected.zh: 2048、8192、16384 token 三档的 fits_estimate 依次为 true、true、false。
expected.en: The 2048, 8192 and 16384-token estimates fit as true, true and false.

body.zh: 针对 16384-token 条件，把序列数从 8 降到 4，单独算 KV。再将权重和工作区加回去，说明是否低于 12.8 GiB，以及降低并发可能影响什么。
body.en: For 16384 tokens, reduce sequences from eight to four and calculate KV. Add weights and workspace back, compare against 12.8 GiB and explain the concurrency trade-off.

expected.zh: KV 变为 8.0 GiB；加上约 1.86 GiB 权重和 2 GiB 工作区，约 11.86 GiB。
expected.en: KV becomes 8.0 GiB; adding about 1.86 GiB weights and 2 GiB workspace gives about 11.86 GiB.

symptom.zh: 估算能放下，真实运行仍 OOM
symptom.en: Estimate fits but a real run still runs out of memory

fix.zh: 检查遗漏的激活、运行时分配、精度和实际可用空间；这里固定的 2 GiB 工作区只是示例假设。
fix.en: Check omitted activations, runtime allocations, precision and actual free memory. The fixed 2 GiB workspace here is merely an assumption.

symptom.zh: 只减权重就认为所有内存都减半
symptom.en: Assuming halved weights halve all memory

fix.zh: KV 与工作区是单独项目；权重量化不自动改变缓存精度或其他缓冲。
fix.en: KV and workspace are separate. Weight quantization does not automatically change cache precision or other buffers.

question.zh: 16 GiB 设备保留 20% 余量，预算上限是多少？
question.en: What budget remains after reserving 20% of 16 GiB?

explanation.en: 16×0.8=12.8; 3.2 is the reserved amount.

question.zh: fits_estimate=true 代表什么？
question.en: What does fits_estimate=true mean?

options.zh: 声明的假设下估算未超预算
options.en: The declared estimate stays within budget
No version can run out of memory

options.zh: 已经完成 GPU 实测

explanation.zh: 实际模型结构和运行时分配可能与示例不同。
explanation.en: Actual architecture and runtime allocations can differ from this example.

title.zh: 建立可复现的基准协议

lesson.zh: 一次截图只能说明有人得到过一个数字，不能让别人重算结论。可复现的实验需要输入、参数、代码版本、环境与原始结果。今天将第 5 天的模拟器变成一个完整实验协议：固定相同输入，运行两种策略各三次，保存清单、每次日志和 CSV。由于模型完全确定，重复值相同是正常现象，并不代表已经获得真实系统的统计置信度。
lesson.en: A screenshot shows that someone obtained a number, but cannot support independent recomputation. Reproducible work requires inputs, parameters, code, environment and raw results. Today turns day 5 into an experiment protocol: identical inputs, two strategies repeated three times, a manifest, raw traces and CSV. The deterministic model should repeat exactly; that does not establish statistical confidence about a real system.

task.zh: 执行三次重复，独立从原始日志重算一个结果，写明输入哈希、代码哈希和唯一改变的变量。
task.en: Run three repeats, recompute one result from raw traces and document input/source hashes and the single changed variable.

title.zh: 哪些条件必须一起保存

body.zh: manifest 记录 Python 与系统版本、到达时间数组、服务时长、批处理开销、重复次数，以及输入和 lab.py 的 SHA-256。哈希用于识别内容变化，不证明程序正确。比较两组结果时，先确认输入与成本规则相同，只有 batch_size 这个变量变化。
body.en: The manifest records Python and OS versions, arrivals, service time, batch overhead, repetitions and SHA-256 of the input and lab.py. A hash identifies content changes; it does not prove correctness. Before comparing results, confirm identical inputs and cost rules, with only batch_size changing.

body.zh: 这次重复验证脚本是否按同样规则重放。如果真实系统存在噪声，还需要记录预热、运行顺序、负载和多次结果分布。不能把确定性模型的零波动写成“性能稳定”。CSV 是摘要，原始逐请求日志才允许检查遗漏和重新计算。
body.en: These repeats verify replay under identical rules. Noisy real systems also require warm-up, run order, workloads and distributions across runs. Zero variation in a deterministic model is not evidence of stable real performance. CSV is a summary; per-request traces allow checking omissions and recomputation.

caption.zh: 原始日志、配置与摘要保持在一起，不能只分享最好看的数字。
caption.en: Keep raw traces, configuration and summaries together rather than sharing only the best-looking number.

body.zh: 运行后打开 day08-manifest.json 与 day08-results.csv。找到 6 行结果，对应 3 次重复和 2 种策略。
body.en: Open day08-manifest.json and day08-results.csv after running. The six result rows correspond to three repeats and two strategies.

expected.zh: 生成 6 个原始日志、一份 manifest 和 6 行数据的 CSV；每种策略的三次模拟结果一致。
expected.en: Produces six raw logs, a manifest and six CSV rows. Each strategy repeats identically.

title.en: Recompute a summary from raw traces

body.zh: 读取第一轮 FIFO 日志，重新计算最大完成时间。再检查 batch4 的对应文件，不依赖 CSV 中已有的摘要。
body.en: Read the first FIFO trace and independently calculate its maximum completion time. Repeat with batch4 rather than relying on the existing CSV.

walkthrough.command: python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('artifacts/day08-run1-batch1.json')); print(max(x['end_ms'] for x in r))"

expected.zh: FIFO 输出 96；换成 day08-run1-batch4.json 后输出 30。
expected.en: FIFO prints 96; changing to day08-run1-batch4.json prints 30.

symptom.zh: 三次运行完全相同，怀疑脚本没运行
symptom.en: All repeats match; wondering whether they ran

fix.zh: 读取三份原始文件并检查 manifest；模型无随机或真实时钟，完全一致是设计结果。
fix.en: Inspect all three traces and the manifest. The model has no randomness or wall-clock input, so identical results are expected.

symptom.zh: 代码哈希改变但没记下改动
symptom.en: Source hash changed without documented edits

fix.zh: 保留你的代码差异与重新运行记录；确认没有比较不同成本模型得出的数值。
fix.en: Save your code diff and rerun record, and check that compared results do not use different cost models.

question.zh: SHA-256 一样可以证明什么？
question.en: What can matching SHA-256 hashes support?

options.zh: 被校验内容没有检测到变化
options.en: No change was detected in the checked content

explanation.zh: 哈希用于内容识别，程序正确性仍需测试与审查。
explanation.en: A hash identifies content; correctness still needs testing and review.

question.zh: 确定性模拟的三次结果相同，应怎样表述？
question.en: How should identical deterministic repeats be described?

options.zh: 证明重放一致，不证明真实系统零波动
options.en: Consistent replay, not zero variation in real systems

options.zh: 可以省略所有原始日志
options.en: All raw logs may be omitted

explanation.zh: 环境噪声与真实执行不在这个模拟中。
explanation.en: Environmental noise and real execution are outside this model.

title.zh: 从指标走到可解释的故障

lesson.zh: 排队增加是一种症状，不足以确定原因。请求突然变多，或者单条服务变慢，都可能让等待变长。今天保持可解释的时间模型，分别注入这两种变化，比较请求到达、开始、完成三个时间点。诊断时先列事实，再提出原因，用能够区分不同原因的证据检验它。
lesson.en: A longer queue is a symptom, not a complete diagnosis. More arrivals or slower per-request service can both increase waiting. Today separately injects these changes into the simple model and compares arrival, start and completion timestamps. Diagnose by listing observations, proposing causes and checking evidence that distinguishes them.

task.zh: 比较三种负载的 trace，为突发与慢服务各写一份短诊断，引用 request_id 和时间字段。
task.en: Compare three trace conditions and write short burst/slow-service diagnoses citing request IDs and timestamps.

evidence.zh: day09 日志和诊断摘要，两份包含原始证据引用的故障说明。
evidence.en: Day 9 traces and summary plus two incident explanations with raw-evidence references.

zh: 能解释本日算例与至少一个限制
执行实验并核对预期结果，保留原始输出
完成两道测验；用自己的话记录一次错误或反例
en: Explain today’s example and at least one limitation
Run the lab, compare expected results and retain raw output
Complete both quizzes and describe one error or counterexample in your own words

noGpu.zh: 本课全程支持普通 CPU 电脑，无需 GPU。使用实验包即可；输出中的模拟时间不可当作真实模型性能。
noGpu.en: This entire course runs on an ordinary CPU computer without a GPU. Use the lab pack; synthetic times are not real model measurements.

title.zh: 从一条 trace 拆开两种时间
title.en: Split two durations from a trace

body.zh: 每条记录有 request_id、arrival_ms、start_ms、end_ms。等待=start−arrival，服务=end−start，整体=等待+服务。request_id 让你追踪同一条请求，而不是把不同阶段的数字误拼在一起。本课没有网络阶段，所以整体恰好是两段之和。
body.en: Each trace has request_id, arrival_ms, start_ms and end_ms. Wait=start−arrival, service=end−start, and total=wait+service. The ID connects stages of the same request instead of mixing unrelated values. This model omits networking, so the total is exactly these two stages.

title.zh: 设计能区分原因的对照

body.zh: 基线每 12 ms 来一条，服务 8 ms；突发组 12 条同时到达，服务仍为 8 ms；慢服务组仍每 12 ms 来一条，但服务变为 20 ms。后两组等待都会增加，但只有慢服务组的 service_ms 变大。实际排障还需核对输入长度、资源、错误与采样，不能只凭一条曲线定因。
body.en: Baseline arrivals are 12 ms apart with 8 ms service. The burst has 12 simultaneous arrivals and unchanged 8 ms service. Slow service keeps 12 ms arrivals but uses 20 ms service. Both increase waiting, but only the latter raises service_ms. Real diagnosis also checks input lengths, resources, errors and sampling rather than asserting cause from one curve.

title.zh: 同一个排队症状，两种原因
title.en: One queue symptom, two possible causes

caption.zh: 先对照原始 trace，再写“到达变化”或“服务变化”的证据。
caption.en: Compare raw traces before attributing the change to arrivals or service.

body.zh: 打开三个 traces 文件和 diagnosis 摘要；选相同 request_id 对比等待与服务。
body.en: Open all three trace files plus the diagnosis summary. Compare wait and service for the same request_id.

expected.zh: baseline/burst/slow_service 的服务 p95 分别是 8/8/20 ms。
expected.en: Service p95 for baseline/burst/slow_service is 8/8/20 ms.

body.zh: 读取慢服务日志，检查第一条与最后一条等待时间，并对照突发组。写四句话：现象、证据、原因假设、下一步验证。不要写没有被模拟的“GPU 故障”。
body.en: Inspect the first and last wait in slow-service traces and compare with the burst. Write four sentences: symptom, evidence, hypothesis and next test. Do not claim an unsimulated GPU failure.

expected.zh: 基线等待 p95=0；突发与慢服务等待 p95 都为 88 ms，但服务 p95 不同。
expected.en: Baseline wait p95=0. Both burst and slow service have wait p95=88 ms, while service p95 differs.

symptom.zh: 只看等待就判定模型执行慢
symptom.en: Inferring slow model execution from queue wait alone

fix.zh: 同时查看 arrival 间隔与 service_ms；本例突发的服务仍是 8 ms。
fix.en: Inspect both arrival spacing and service_ms; burst service is still 8 ms here.

symptom.zh: 把日志顺序当成请求身份
symptom.en: Using log position as request identity

fix.zh: 用 request_id 对齐记录；真实异步系统的输出顺序可能与输入不同。
fix.en: Join records by request_id. Real asynchronous systems can return results in a different order.

question.zh: 突发组等待增加，但 service_ms 仍为 8，最直接的证据支持什么？
question.en: Burst waiting rises but service_ms remains 8. What is directly supported?

explanation.zh: 实验中唯一改变的是到达方式；不能从排队推断硬件损坏。
explanation.en: The changed experimental variable is arrival timing, not hardware health.

question.zh: start=20、arrival=5、end=28，服务时长是多少？
question.en: start=20, arrival=5, end=28. What is service duration?

explanation.zh: 服务=end−start=8；15 是等待，23 是总时长。
explanation.en: Service=end−start=8; 15 is waiting and 23 is total latency.

title.zh: 交付第一份 AI Infra 工程作品
title.en: Ship your first AI Infra portfolio

lesson.zh: 结课作品应该让别人看懂你解决了什么问题、具体做了什么、哪些结论有证据。运行示例是起点，独立贡献可以是自己实现指标函数、改一项到达策略并分析反例，或改进错误检测。今天从干净输出目录重跑，生成报告骨架，再用自己的文字填写贡献、失败与局限。所有模拟结果必须保留教学标签。
lesson.en: A final project should show the problem, your contribution and the evidence behind each conclusion. Running an example is a starting point. Independent contributions can include metric functions, an arrival-policy experiment with counterexamples or better error checks. Today reruns into a clean output directory, generates a report scaffold and fills it with your contributions, failures and limitations. Synthetic results must retain their teaching labels.

task.zh: 从新输出目录复现全部实验，完成独立指标函数与报告；录制或向同伴讲解三分钟项目，区分示例与本人贡献。
task.en: Reproduce all experiments into a fresh output folder, finish your metric functions and report, and give a three-minute walkthrough distinguishing reference work from your contribution.

evidence.zh: 完整作品目录、final-artifacts/REPORT.md、独立代码差异与验收结果；实际发生后再加入同伴复现记录。
evidence.en: A complete project, final-artifacts/REPORT.md, independent code diff and check results; add peer reproduction evidence only when it occurs.

zh: 独立实现 student.py，通过自己的边界验收
从新目录复现，报告中没有待填写的贡献 TODO
结论能追溯到原始日志，模拟/CPU实测及本人贡献区分清楚
en: Independently implement student.py and pass your own boundary checks
Reproduce into a new folder and replace contribution TODOs
Link conclusions to raw traces and distinguish simulation, CPU timing and your own work

noGpu.zh: 本课全程支持普通 CPU 电脑，无需 GPU。使用实验包即可；输出中的模拟时间不可当作真实模型性能。
noGpu.en: This entire course runs on an ordinary CPU computer without a GPU. Use the lab pack; synthetic times are not real model measurements.

title.zh: 作品由证据与解释共同组成

body.zh: 实验包自动导出原始 JSON/JSONL、CSV、环境与哈希、REPORT.md。报告预填教学示例结论，但“我的独立贡献”故意留空。你需要填写 student.py 的实现、验收结果、自己改变的变量以及一个未获收益的条件。复制课程代码不能写成从零开发完整推理系统。
body.en: The lab exports raw JSON/JSONL, CSV, environment/hash records and REPORT.md. The scaffold includes teaching observations but deliberately leaves your contribution blank. Fill in student.py changes, checks, your changed variable and one no-benefit condition. Copying examples is not building a complete inference system from scratch.

title.en: Explain the project in three minutes

body.zh: 第一分钟介绍一个具体问题，例如批处理何时有用；第二分钟展示原始记录和对照表；第三分钟解释稀疏请求的反例，以及为什么不能外推成 GPU 性能。准备回答：如果换成真实 vLLM，需要重新测量哪些量？这比只展示“我完成 10 天”更能表达能力。
body.en: In minute one, state a question such as when batching helps. In minute two, show raw records and the comparison. In minute three, explain the sparse-arrival counterexample and why results do not establish GPU performance. Be ready to name what must be measured again with real vLLM. This demonstrates more than a completion checkmark.

nodes.en: Rerun in a clean output folder

caption.zh: 参考代码与自己的修改分开描述；没有同伴复核时如实标为未复核。
caption.en: Describe reference code separately from your edits. Mark peer reproduction unverified until it happens.

body.zh: 命令会重新运行前 9 天并写入一个新输出目录 final-artifacts。只覆盖同名输出文件，不会修改 student.py。先完成 student.py，再运行独立验收。
body.en: This reruns days 1–9 into final-artifacts. It overwrites only same-named output files and does not modify student.py. Finish student.py and run its independent checks.

walkthrough.command:
python3 lab.py day10 --out final-artifacts
python3 check.py

expected.zh: 生成 final-artifacts/REPORT.md、原始日志与 CSV；自己的挑战实现应显示 PASS。
expected.en: Produces final-artifacts/REPORT.md, raw traces and CSV. Your challenge implementation should print PASS.

body.zh: 用编辑器打开 REPORT.md，替换“我的独立贡献”里的 TODO，加入源码/数据相对路径、修改说明和一次反例。保留模拟边界；确认没有个人敏感信息，再整理为作品档案。
body.en: Open REPORT.md and replace the contribution TODO with source/data paths, your changes and a counterexample. Keep simulation limits, check for private data, then assemble a portfolio.

expected.zh: 报告能对应到环境、代码哈希、输入与原始结果；同伴可按 README 重跑。
expected.en: The report links to environment, source hash, input and raw results; a peer can rerun using README.

symptom.zh: check.py 显示 NOT YET
symptom.en: check.py prints NOT YET

fix.zh: 先实现 student.py 两个函数。--reference 只验证课程参考，不代表你的独立实现已经通过。
fix.en: Implement both student.py functions. --reference checks the supplied reference, not your independent implementation.

symptom.zh: 报告仍有 TODO，或说自己测了 GPU
symptom.en: Report retains TODO or claims a GPU measurement

fix.zh: 填写自己的实际修改，明确第 4 天是本机 CPU，其余主要是教学模拟。没有真实引擎记录就不写 GPU/模型加速结论。
fix.en: Describe your actual changes. Day 4 times local CPU work; other main results are teaching simulations. Without engine records, do not claim GPU/model speedups.

question.zh: 哪种作品表述准确？
question.en: Which portfolio statement is accurate?

options.zh: 已证明所有推理系统都能加速 3 倍
options.en: Proved every inference system can be 3× faster

options.zh: 在声明的队列模型里比较两种策略，并解释反例
options.en: Compared two policies under a declared queue model and explained a counterexample

options.zh: 运行示例就成为生产专家

explanation.zh: 结论应限定于实际完成的实验和假设。
explanation.en: Limit claims to the completed experiment and its assumptions.

question.zh: 参考解法通过验收，能否说明你的 student.py 已通过？
question.en: If the reference passes, has your student.py passed?

options.zh: 不能，必须单独运行自己的实现
options.en: No, check your own implementation separately

explanation.zh: 不带 --reference 的 check.py 才检查 student.py。
explanation.en: check.py without --reference checks student.py.

description.zh: Python 3.9+ · 无需第三方依赖 · 普通电脑可运行。解压后先读 README.md；命令从 foundations 文件夹执行。
description.en: Python 3.9+ · no third-party dependencies · runs on a laptop. Unzip, read README.md and run commands inside the foundations folder.
